name: forms-responder
description: Careful browser form workflows with source review and optional local study memory; never submits.

interface.shortDescription: Careful browser form answers that never submit
interface.longDescription: Carefully completes and audits browser forms, LMS pages, surveys, and source-based questions. Reviews required videos and readings, verifies every answer, always leaves final submission to the user, and can save confirmed quiz records locally for later study.
defaultPrompt: Complete this browser form carefully and stop before submission.
Review this form's video or reading and answer from evidence.
Create an exam study summary from my saved quiz records.
